title: senna perrieri
intro: Senna perrieri, commonly known as the Malagasy senna, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include the treatment of digestive issues such as constipation and diarrhea due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna perrieri are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements, which can help relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Senna perrieri include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin and chrysophanic acid, which contribute to its laxative and anti-inflammatory effects.
